Description: "Added a generic checkPosAccess(category, key) helper that checks pos_access permissions with supervisor bypass. Used it to gate: Billing Total Bar buttons (preview, print, discount, charges), Billing Tab buttons (save bill, print & save, settle, payment), Quick Bill buttons (payment, settle), Old KOT Modal buttons (complementary, print, delete, cancel, transfer), and F2/F3/F4 keyboard shortcuts. Disabled buttons show a toast warning and the action is blocked."
Instruction: "Add checkPosAccess helper function after getDashboardAccess, then gate all Billing buttons, KOT modal buttons, and keyboard shortcuts with permission checks."
